headline: US Announces $8 Billion Harvest Fuel Relief Program for Farmers
summary: The Agriculture Department will launch the Harvest Fuel Relief Program to provide $8 billion in economic aid for farmers hurt by high diesel prices.
why: Agricultural producers face intensive operational costs tied to fuel and energy prices, making federal subsidies a critical factor for farm sector profitability.

impacts.name: Agriculture
impacts.why: Direct financial aid cushions agricultural producers against the negative impact of elevated diesel fuel expenses.
